# T-3: Preserve plugin behavior

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Keep existing public plugin command result shapes, config persistence, and materialization behavior while changing only Git URL resolved commits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- plugin update-all JSON keeps commit/previousCommit/updated fields and reports updated:true when commit changes.
- plugin source add/update/find/install retain result shape and config write behavior.
- setup official preset resolution still installs and validates official preset packages.
- .senti/config.json and .senti/config.local.json overlay behavior remains unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Map retained public surfaces to existing owners in src/plugin.js and src/lib/plugin-registry.js. Do not change help output unless required by behavior.

## Test Strategy
Add behavior-level coverage for update-all JSON and representative source add/update/find/install or existing shared tests where public contracts already exist.
